justification: In posting.content, the listed responsibilities are release and CI/CD engineering, not building, integrating, or operating AI systems: "Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification."
